subject: Showtime, my view..
author: ZombieTron
body:
I do quite like showtime, but for me it is a fun way to get somewhere else on the map or to get the high showtime score of the day if I do a crash with potential.

I know its not the game mode I am going to be playing most, and it is different to the Crash modes we know from previous Burnouts. The first time I played Showtime it reminded me of Stone Skipping in FlatoutUC but I think there is much more to Showtime than that! hitting buses for multipliers is a cool touch! 🙂

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: It's a minute and half of
author: Psykoboy2
body:
It's a minute and half of footage and I just don't know if I like what I am seeing there.

It still needs to digest for me. I can find some high points of what I am looking at, but still - I'm nervous. I've learned over the years to trust Criterion. Everything before that I have been nervous about I've come to love, but yeah...I guess I just need to let this settle in with me and then I can find the enjoyment of it.

The jury, for me, is still out on if I'll like Showtime or not.
